# Game Idea: Neon Drift

**Genre:** Endless runner (space)

**Core Loop:** Player moves left/right to avoid oncoming obstacles in an HTML canvas.

**Goal:** Collect as many energy orbs as possible for points.

**Lose Condition:** Collision with an obstacle ends the game.

<content>
1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 400;
9: 
10:   // Starfield background
11:   const stars = [];
12:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
13:     stars.push({
14:       x: Math.random() * width,
15:       y: Math.random() * height,
16:       size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
17:       speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2
18:     });
19:   }
20: 
21:   // Audio assets
22:   const soundCollect = new Audio('https://www.soundjay.com/button/sounds/button-16.mp3');
23:   const soundHit = new Audio('https://www.soundjay.com/button/sounds/button-10.mp3');
24:   const soundBg = new Audio('https://www.soundjay.com/ambient/sounds/space-ambient-2.mp3');
25:   soundBg.loop = true;
26:   // Start background after first user interaction
27:   const startAudio = () => { soundBg.play(); window.removeEventListener('keydown', startAudio); };
28:   window.addEventListener('keydown', startAudio);
29: 
30: 
31:   // Player definition
32:   const player = {
33:     w: 40,
34:     h: 40,
35:     x: width / 2 - 20,
36:     y: height - 60,
37:     speed: 5,
38:     color: '#0ff'
39:   };
40: 
41:   const obstacles = [];
42:   const orbs = [];
43:   let score = 0;
44:   let gameOver = false;
45: 
46:   // Input handling
47:   const keys = {};
48:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
49:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
50: 
51:   function spawnObstacle() {
52:     const size = 30 + Math.random() * 30;
53:     obstacles.push({
54:       w: size,
55:       h: size,
56:       x: Math.random() * (width - size),
57:       y: -size,
58:       speed: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
59:       color: '#f44'
60:     });
61:   }
62: 
63:   function spawnOrb() {
64:     const r = 8 + Math.random() * 8;
65:     orbs.push({
66:       r,
67:       x: Math.random() * (width - 2 * r) + r,
68:       y: -r,
69:       speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
70:       color: '#ff0'
71:     });
72:   }
73: 
74:   function rectCollision(a, b) {
75:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
76:   }
77: 
78:   function circleRectCollision(circle, rect) {
79:     const distX = Math.abs(circle.x - rect.x - rect.w / 2);
80:     const distY = Math.abs(circle.y - rect.y - rect.h / 2);
81:     if (distX > (rect.w / 2 + circle.r)) return false;
82:     if (distY > (rect.h / 2 + circle.r)) return false;
83:     if (distX <= (rect.w / 2)) return true;
84:     if (distY <= (rect.h / 2)) return true;
85:     const dx = distX - rect.w / 2;
86:     const dy = distY - rect.h / 2;
87:     return (dx * dx + dy * dy <= (circle.r * circle.r));
88:   }
89: 
90:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
91:   let orbTimer = 0;
92: 
93:   function update(delta) {
94:     if (gameOver) return;
95:     // Player movement
96:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) player.x -= player.speed;
97:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) player.x += player.speed;
98:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - player.w, player.x));
99: 
100:     // Spawn obstacles/orbs
101:     obstacleTimer += delta;
102:     orbTimer += delta;
103:     if (obstacleTimer > 1500) { spawnObstacle(); obstacleTimer = 0; }
104:     if (orbTimer > 1000) { spawnOrb(); orbTimer = 0; }
105: 
106:     // Update obstacles
107:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
108:       const o = obstacles[i];
109:       o.y += o.speed;
110:       if (rectCollision(player, o)) { soundHit.currentTime = 0; soundHit.play(); gameOver = true; }
111:       if (o.y > height) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
112:     }
113: 
114:     // Update orbs
115:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
116:       const orb = orbs[i];
117:       orb.y += orb.speed;
118:       if (circleRectCollision(orb, player)) {
119:         score += 10;
120:         soundCollect.currentTime = 0;
121:         soundCollect.play();
122:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
123:       } else if (orb.y - orb.r > height) {
124:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
125:       }
126:     }
127:   }
128: 
129:   function draw() {
130:     // Draw moving starfield
131:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
132:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
133:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
134:     stars.forEach(star => {
135:       ctx.beginPath();
136:       ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
137:       ctx.fill();
138:       // Move star downwards for parallax effect
139:       star.y += star.speed;
140:       if (star.y > height) {
141:         star.y = 0;
142:         star.x = Math.random() * width;
143:       }
144:     });
145: 
146:     // Player with neon glow
147:     ctx.save();
148:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
149:     ctx.shadowColor = player.color;
150:     ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
151:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
152:     ctx.restore();
153: 
154:     // Obstacles with gradient fill
155:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
156:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(o.x, o.y, o.x + o.w, o.y + o.h);
157:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#f66');
158:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#900');
159:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
160:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
161:     });
162: 
163:     // Orbs with glow effect
164:     orbs.forEach(orb => {
165:       ctx.save();
166:       ctx.fillStyle = orb.color;
167:       ctx.shadowColor = orb.color;
168:       ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
169:       ctx.beginPath();
170:       ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, orb.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
171:       ctx.fill();
172:       ctx.restore();
173:     });
174: 
175:     // Score overlay
176:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
177:     ctx.font = '20px Arial';
178:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 30);
179:     if (gameOver) {
180:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
181:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
182:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
183:       ctx.font = '40px Arial';
184:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
185:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
186:     }
187:   }
188: 
189:   let last = performance.now();
190:   function loop(now) {
191:     const delta = now - last;
192:     last = now;
193:     update(delta);
194:     draw();
195:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
196:   }
197:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
198: })();

(End of file - total 198 lines)
</content>
